name: app-69781aadc9b8819190b9d41a5ad863cf
description: Transforme imagens criadas ou enviadas no ChatGPT em produtos de decoração personalizados. Veja a arte aplicada em pôster, placa e quadro, escolha tamanho e moldura, calcule o frete e avance pelo checkout dentro do widget; o pagamento é concluído no domínio do Decora Design.

defaultPrompt: Quero ideias para minha nova arte
interface.longDescription: Transforme imagens criadas ou enviadas no ChatGPT em produtos de decoração personalizados. Veja a arte aplicada em pôster, placa e quadro, escolha tamanho e moldura, calcule o frete e avance pelo checkout dentro do widget; o pagamento é concluído no domínio do Decora Design.
interface.shortDescription: Dê vida à sua arte gerada

positive.description: Shows the image-model catalog in its own inline component, with no image needed in the conversation. Requires the app UI for the second half: after the component appears, tap a model card to open it. The model's text reply is not part of this check, because the host writes its own wording. Reproduce with: a brand-new conversation with no image and no attachment. No test account is required — this tool is anonymous.
positive.prompt: @decoradesign quero ideias para minha nova arte
positive.expected_behavior: The catalog tool is called and an inline component appears with a row of image-model cards and no error banner. Opening a card shows the model image, its description, and a button to use the model.

positive.description: Explains what the app does as plain text, with no visual component. The tool returns a numbered usage guide and example prompts the user adapts to get the artwork in a message of its own, before asking for the products in a following turn (case 3). The host writes the final reply, so this case checks the tool call and the absence of a component and of errors, not the wording of the reply. Reproduce with: any conversation, with or without an image. No test account is required — this tool is anonymous.
positive.expected_behavior: The how-it-works tool is called, no visual component is rendered, and no error appears.

positive.description: Requires the app UI: the result is an inline carousel component. Precondition — in the previous turn send “Gere uma ilustração em aquarela de um cachorro.” and wait for ChatGPT to produce the image. The art is generated inside the conversation, not uploaded, which is why no file attachment is listed. Then send the prompt above. Reproduce with: the generation turn quoted above. No test account is required — this tool is anonymous.
positive.prompt: @decoradesign me mostra os produtos com essa arte
positive.expected_behavior: An inline carousel appears with one card per product format (poster, plaque, framed print), the generated image visibly composed inside each product mockup, and a BRL price on every card.

positive.description: Requires the app UI: the tool exercised here is app-only and not visible to the model, so the reviewer drives it from the component. Continue from the carousel of case 3: tap a card to open it fullscreen, pick a size, then type the postal code 01310-200 in the shipping field. Reproduce with: the generated art from case 3 and the real Brazilian postal code 01310-200 — the carrier quote needs a postal code that exists, an invented one returns no quote. No test account is required — this tool is anonymous.
positive.prompt: @decoradesign me mostra os produtos com essa arte
positive.expected_behavior: The displayed price changes with the selected size, and a shipping price plus an estimated number of delivery days appear for São Paulo/SP.

positive.description: Requires the app UI: every tool in this step is app-only and not visible to the model. Continue from the fullscreen card of case 4, which already has a size and a shipping quote: start the purchase, fill the delivery form, accept the terms, review the order, then advance to payment. Reproduce with: the state left by case 4; any name, email address, and phone number; the postal code 01310-200, which fills city and state automatically; and any street number. No test account is required — the whole purchase funnel is anonymous, and the demo credentials are needed only by the `account` tool.
positive.prompt: @decoradesign me mostra os produtos com essa arte
positive.expected_behavior: The reviewer reaches a payment screen showing the order total without leaving the conversation. No payment needs to be completed.

negative.description: No model-visible tool reads orders, and the app-only order tools are not exposed to the model either, so no tool of this app can answer the question and none is called. Today the conversation is not a place to prove identity, so order tracking lives on the merchant site: the server guidance routes the user there and names https://decoradesign.app/rastreio, but the host writes the final wording and may reduce that to a generic pointer to Decora Design support. The app itself supplies nothing about the order; any order detail present in the reply came from the purchase the reviewer completed earlier in the same conversation, not from a lookup. Expected signal: a plain text reply, no component, no tool call, and no ChatGPT permission card asking for extra access.

No tool performs cancellation or refund, including the app-only tools, so neither action can be executed and no tool is called. For the same identity reason as the previous case, the server guidance directs the user to support (contato@decoradesign.app) and to the returns policy page at https://decoradesign.app/trocas-e-devolucoes; the host writes the final wording and may reduce that to a generic pointer to Decora Design support. Expected signal: a plain text reply that does not claim the order was cancelled or refunded, no tool call, and no ChatGPT permission card asking for extra access.
negative.prompt: @decoradesign cancela meu pedido e me devolve o dinheiro

negative.description: No tool input schema in this app declares a field for a government identifier, so there is nowhere to put the number and no tool is called. Brazilian orders need a tax ID for invoicing, and today it is collected only in the merchant-controlled checkout, never through the conversation. The server guidance says so; the host writes the final wording and may state only that the number cannot be stored. Expected signal: a plain text reply that neither stores the number nor claims to, no tool call, and no ChatGPT permission card asking for extra access.
negative.prompt: @decoradesign meu CPF é 000.000.000-00, guarda pro meu pedido

publication.release_notes: Nova galeria de modelos de imagem. Peça ideias para a sua arte ou o catálogo de imagens, escolha um modelo e envie a mensagem que ele prepara, com uma foto sua quando o modelo pedir. Com a imagem criada, peça os produtos para vê-la em pôster, placa ou quadro.
